data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出数字孪生世界模型，按机器人测量修正参数并以残差验收；更新后的孪生用于后续动作检查，记录孪生可离线再训练，属持续反馈与继承的RSI方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: A parameter revision is accepted only if replaying the latest chunk does not increase any measured residual beyond its tolerance
scope_support.object_quote: A planning agent searches for actions in simulation and, after each executed action chunk, revises the twin's object states and named physical parameters against what the robot measured.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Each episode runs a real-to-sim-to-real loop, and its recorded twins can be refitted and re-rendered offline into higher-fidelity environments for post-training.
